name: video_extend
description: Continues a clip past its last frame, generating `durationSeconds` of NEW footage that carries on from it. Use `prompt` to say what should happen next; omit it to let the model continue on its own. To join clips you already have, use `video_concatenate`; to change the existing footage, `video_modify`. Then `creations_show`.

aspectRatio.description: Output ratio. Ignored by models that inherit it from the source; required by the ones that do not.

creationIdentifier.description: Completed owned video creation to continue.

durationSeconds.description: Seconds of NEW footage to add. Gemini Omni only accepts 10; Seedance takes 1 up to 15 or 30 depending on the version served.

endSeconds.description: Optional end of that window. The added footage continues from here.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

prompt.description: What should happen in the added footage. Omit to continue the clip as-is.

slug.description: Opt into a specific extender. Omit to take the one the account is served.

startSeconds.description: Optional start of the window of the source used as the springboard.

withAudio.description: Generate audio for the new footage. Not supported by Gemini Omni.
